title: The Orphanage Rations Distribution
statement:
You have N children and M cookies. Child i has a greed factor G[i], which is the minimum size of a cookie that will make the child content. Cookie j has size S[j].

Each child can be given at most one cookie, and a cookie can only satisfy child i if S[j] >= G[i]. Maximize the number of content children.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and M.
Second line: N space-separated integers G[i].
Third line: M space-separated integers S[j].
outputFormat: Print the maximum number of satisfied children.

sampleCases.explanation: Only child with greed 1 can be satisfied.
